_comment: Runner configuration. Plan names and variants are data, not code: whichever way Q1 is answered (OID4VP 1.0 Final vs the ID2 draft), switching target is an edit here rather than a change to the runner. The ngrok host is per-developer, so override `endpoint` locally or via configs/runner.local.json.

components.description: Inji Verify 0.18.2 - OID4VP 1.0 Final alpha verifier - automated run

planConfig._comment_browser: The happy-flow module wants a screenshot of the verifier's verification-result page before it reaches REVIEW. AbstractVP1FinalVerifierTest serves an HTML stand-in at the verification-evidence path and fills the placeholder through browser automation when a matching entry exists, so this block is what makes an unattended run possible. Confirm the match pattern against a live run before trusting it.

_certify_note: Inji Certify is absent deliberately rather than stubbed. Its docker-compose-injistack needs a PKCS12 keystore from Mimoto onboarding, a public DID endpoint, an external authorisation server and partner API keys; Mukta owns standing that up (see docs/PLAN.md). A stub here would make --combined appear to work when it cannot.
